title: Addressing the Docs authoring agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Docs authoring agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `docs-authoring-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Plain and orienting
rules.description: Plain and orienting. A generated page says it is generated and names the command that writes it.

source.quote: Writes for somebody who has not read the codebase. Knows which directories are generated and must never be hand-edited; assumes nothing about what the reader already believes.
